profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer w/ Secret Clearance
profile.summary:
C# developer with current active Secret Clearance looking to bring over 25 years of software engineering experience.

Specialties: Winforms, C#, .Net, .Net Framework, .Net Core, SQL, Windows Security, Cryptography, mail sorters.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
A Senior Software Engineer at Squadra on a USAF defense contract with Northrop Grumman using a secret clearance.

• Utilized VS.net, .NET Core 8, .Net Framework 4.8, ASP.NET Core, Winforms, C#, Git, Nuget, MsBuild, and Jenkins to develop and maintain robust software solutions.
• Implemented asynchronous request-reply design pattern in a RESTful ASP.Net Core web API backend, enabling efficient processing of long-running multithreaded tasks and improving system responsiveness.
• Prevented Winforms UI blocking by implementing async/await and multithreading, resulting in smoother user experiences and increased application reliability.
• Optimized performance of algorithms, data structures, and threading, reducing calculation time by 50% or more to enhance overall application efficiency.  Used profilers, timing code and understanding of the system to find the bottlenecks on what to improve.
• Optimized UI drawing code to accelerate map rendering, improving visualization speed and user interaction.
• Supported a large legacy code base and debugged numerous complicated existing bugs through many levels of code.
• Wrote tools for developers to make it easier to log out debugging info and parse it to identify how the system was working
• Wrote script for developers to make it faster and less error prone to setup up developer machines.
• Used Fortify static code analysis along with secure coding practices to ensure a secure code base.
positions.insights: Skills: .NET · Graphical User Interface (GUI) · Git · .NET Core · .NET Framework · Debugging · Multithreaded Development · ASP.NET Web API · C# · DevOps · Performance Tuning · ASP.NET Core · WinForms · Multithreading · Cybersecurity · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Active DoD Secret Clearance · MSBuild

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
A Senior Software Engineer at Softek International on a USAF defense contract with Northrop Grumman using a secret clearance.

• Utilized VS.net, .NET core, .Net Framework, Winforms, C#, Git, Nuget, MsBuild, and Jenkins
• Utilized asynchronous request-reply design pattern in ASP.Net Core web api service backend to process long running tasks
• Prevented Winforms UI blocking by implementing async/await and multithreading.
• Standardized organization and versioning of custom libraries using Nuget and customizing MsBuild scripts.
• Optimized build order of numerous projects and Modified Jenkins scripts to ensure correct builds.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked with C# and T- SQL to support supply chain management.
- SQL
-- Wrote numerous stored procedures to manipulate data from the SQL server for use by C# and SSRS
-- Performance optimized queries. Both by restructuring queries and optimizing indexes
- C#
-- Added code to a WinForms app to implement needed functionality
-- Using .net core implemented microservices that used entity framework to get data from sql stored procs

positions.description: Working on a connect iq data field that runs on Gamin devices and written in Monkey C. Handled pairing over ant+ to connect to the muscle oxygen sensor, processing the data, and displaying to the user.
positions.insights: Skills: Programming · Debugging · Problem Solving · Sports Coaching · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Garmin

positions.title: Senior Programmer Analyst
positions.description:
- Led efforts to fix some deadlocking and other error conditions seen in stored procedures running in production.
- Led efforts to optimize the performance of queries run against SQL server to greatly decrease load on server and increase response time.
- Work directly with clients from various departments and colleges within Johns Hopkins University.
- During regular sprint cycles, work on backlog items; during Production Support sprints, handle high priority incoming tickets.  
- Support Self-Service, the student and faculty website and large database backend for grade tracking, class registration, student-aid, bill payments, etc.
• Used: SQL server, C#, VB, SSRS,SourceTree (GIT), TortoiseSVN

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked on the MezoCliq project as lead developer as a contractor for Guggenheim, a financial company. 
• Created software that interfaced with Bloomberg services to retreive market data and combine with existing data on an internal sql server backend along with a web interface with .net web services to send data to the finacial product MezoCliq MarketData to process.  Also supported other applications in production.
• Worked with a RabbitMQ message queue for how that app processed some requests.
• Create SDL processes based using Octopus, Nuget packages, proget to be able to quickly deploy and test code changes as they were checked in.
• Worked with other developers to help troubleshoot memory leaks, threading issues, and SQL performance issues.
• Worked with an Agile process using Jira for tracking work.
Used: Sql Server, C#, RabbitMQ, ASP.NET, JQuery, Unity, log4net, Octopus, Proget, powershell.

positions.title: Senior Developer
positions.description:
Worked on the US Citizenship and Immigration Service (USCIS/SPAS) contract as a developer on the CPMS team (fingerprints and photo web service) and the Clams3 team (end user information collection tool). 

- The lead developer on the component that interfaced with an image scanner to pull photos into the application and tweak the images.
- Developed c# .net WinForms applications that processed immigration forms with a sql database backend using Agile/Kanban as a development process.
- The lead developer for fixing performance, threading and memory leak issues that came up.
- Improved error handling of web services to track down bugs that were being hit in production.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
Worked on the Census Bureau’s 2010 Decennial Response Integration System (DRIS) program as a developer on the paper team and the same role on the 2011 UK Census. 

- Technical expert in charge of the mail sorters used in the 2010 Census.  Both for software interfacing with the data coming out of the sorters and for handling the physical machines
- Developed and supported c# .net applications that processed the paper forms. Both WinForms for keyers and backend services that processed the data with an Oracle backend database.  This was done during development, test runs, and production.
- The lead developer for fixing performance, threading and memory leak issues. Including adding threading and other performance enhancements for scaling an application to take less than an hour to run from taking multiple days.
- Created tools to simplify the job of system administrators handling large numbers of systems at one time.
- Handled both development of the system and production support while the census was being done.

positions.description:
Created an application to manage users in AD and how the accounts map with two external sources (mail and database).

Contracted out to Advertising.com. Created backend code that had to handle 100+ million events per second. Later worked on a validation engine to validate the stored information in objects.

positions.title: ISA
positions.description:
-	Performed hardware, software, and configuration troubleshooting for Digex customers.  
-	Wrote tools in C# to help automate repetitive work and decrease the resolution time of cases including:
-	Opsadmin – UI designed to be small and unobtrusive to the user to contain functionality to gain information about a server quickly and easily.
-	Pinger – Designed to make keeping track of patching servers easier which enabled the patching to go much faster and with quicker responses to problems
-	Utilized my coding skills in .Net, ASP, and SQL to help other engineers in application development and customer support.

positions.description:
Worked in the testing team for Internet Information Services (IIS). Tested IIS 6 with respect to UNC file shares, including the review and testing of the security underpinnings.

Helped to design and test the IIS lockdown tool for IIS 4 and 5.

Proofread chapters in the book "Writing Secure Code," by Michael Howard and David LeBlanc, resulting in acknowledgement in the text.
